title.narrative: Research and Needs-assessment in Obalanga and Kapelebyong sub-counties

description.narrative: The research project will provide detailed research and needs-assessment to establish possible project areas to help the vulnerable conflict-affected people of this region. A likely focus is for sustainable solutions, particularly focusing on education, food security, and livelihoods for the communities returning from displacement camps. This region is currently suffering from the funding gap between aid and development that is typical of conflict-affected areas, and this research would strive to find methods of overcoming this and bridging this gap. Having been interrupted and displaced by armed conflicts and still experiencing Karimajong warrior invasions, many people are unable to maintain livelihoods; children suffer interrupted education; the rate of child headed families is high; and the rate of HIV-Aids spread is increasing. This research would provide a piece of learning that can be used to overcome these challenges. The learning would filter into projects to be run by the SI-VAD partnership as well as being disseminated amongst other Ugandan practitioners in the area. The research would further feed into Comic Relief's research topic of 'What are the key elements needed to ensure that conflict affected families and young people have sustainable and secure livelihoods?' thereby also contributing to international learning and debate.
